title: Whamamerica! (The Tour): USA Stadiums 1985 Band Itinerary

description.main: The band itinerary issued to Wham! and their touring party for Whamamerica!, the duo's US stadium tour of August and September 1985. It holds the master schedule, a routing map, the full touring and crew lists, and a day sheet for each show.
description.extended:
The band itinerary issued to Wham! and their touring party for Whamamerica!, the duo's US stadium tour of August and September 1985, compiled by their tour manager Jake Duncan.

The cover shows a highway billboard under searchlights reading Whamāmerica! (The Tour) above the word "starring", the band's name already built into the title, with a tour bus on the road below. Inside, "Making Whamtracks!" sets out the schedule from full rehearsals at the Brixton Academy on 16 August to the return to the UK on 11 September, through Poplar Creek, Toronto, Hollywood Park, Oakland, Houston, Miami, Philadelphia and the Pontiac Silverdome. A routing map follows, then two pages listing everyone on the road: George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley, managers Jazz Summers and Simon Napier-Bell, the band, the dancers Pepsi DeMacque, Shirlie Holliman and Danny John-Jules, and a crew that includes Mark Fisher as set designer. A key of pictograms covers restaurants, 24-hour fuel, the local doctor, the Samaritans and an e-mail access number at 300 baud. The Los Angeles day sheet draws the front of a bus around both hotels and the running order: Katrina and the Waves, Chaka Khan, then Wham! from 21:00 to 22:30.

Duncan, from Dunbar in Scotland, signed the back cover with his "Aye For Detail" mark and a map of Scotland. He had run The Big Tour and the April 1985 China dates for Wham!, and went on to manage George Michael's Faith Tour in 1988-89.
description.artist_bio: Wham! were George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley. Make It Big (1984) took them to the top of the US charts; they played China in April 1985 and split after The Final at Wembley Stadium in June 1986.

notes: Printed for the touring party, not sold. The cover sets the title as Whamāmerica!, with a macron over the middle a. Back cover: "Aye For Detail" mark with a map of Scotland, and "Itinerary Concept: Jake Duncan". Interior photographs are shown on this page.

sources_checked: Object in hand (cover, back cover, seven interior pages photographed)
